physicalNotes: Radius 0.204 +/- 0.004 solar radii from Hori et al. 2024, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-2406 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....167..289H/abstract): 141,923 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Temperature 3100 +/- 31 K from Hori et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-2406 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....167..289H/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
